description: Pollo en Mole is a deeply flavorful and iconic Mexican dish featuring tender chicken bathed in a rich, complex mole sauce. This recipe guides you through creating a balanced sauce with a delightful blend of smoky chiles, spices, nuts, and a hint of chocolate. It is a true celebration of Mexican culinary tradition, perfect for a special family meal.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large pot, combine chicken thighs with 4 cups of chicken broth and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken, reserving the broth. Let chicken cool slightly, then remove skin and bones, shredding the meat. Set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Chiles
instructions.text: Lightly toast the dried ancho, mulato, and pasilla chiles in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes per side until fragrant. Be careful not to burn them. Transfer the toasted chiles to a bowl and cover with hot water. Let them rehydrate for 15-20 minutes, then drain, reserving some soaking liquid.

instructions.title: Toast Spices and Aromatics
instructions.text: In the same dry skillet, toast almonds, sesame seeds, raisins, cinnamon stick, cloves, cumin seeds, and black peppercorns until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add 1 tablespoon of lard or oil to the skillet, then sauté the chopped onion, garlic, and roma tomatoes until softened, about 5-7 minutes.

instructions.title: Blend the Mole Sauce
instructions.text: Combine the rehydrated chiles, toasted nuts/seeds/spices, sautéed aromatics, and chopped Mexican chocolate in a blender. Add 1 cup of the reserved chicken broth and a splash of chile soaking liquid. Blend until very smooth, adding more broth or soaking liquid if needed to achieve a thick, pourable consistency. Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl to remove any solids, pressing down with a spoon.

instructions.title: Simmer the Mole
instructions.text: Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of lard or oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Carefully pour in the strained mole sauce. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Reduce heat to low and continue to simmer for at least 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and deepened in color and flavor. Season with salt to taste.

instructions.title: Combine and Serve
instructions.text: Add the shredded cooked chicken to the mole sauce and stir to coat thoroughly. Allow it to simmer for another 5-10 minutes, ensuring the chicken is heated through and absorbs the flavors of the mole. Serve hot with warm tortillas, rice, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds for garnish. Enjoy this traditional Mexican delicacy!

tags: Pollo en Mole Chicken Mole Sauce
tips: To achieve a truly smooth mole, do not skip the straining step. It removes any lingering chile skins or spice fragments, resulting in a silky texture.
The secret to a deep, rich mole is the slow simmering. The flavors need time to meld and develop. Do not rush this step.
Mole is even better the next day! Prepare the sauce in advance and gently reheat it with the chicken for an enhanced flavor experience.
